title: How many patients with a normal Ig A level came to the hospital after 1990/
question:
How many patients with a normal Ig A level came to the hospital after 1990/1/1?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: normal Ig A level refers to IGA > 80 AND IGA < 500; came to the hospital after 1990/1/1 refers to YEAR(`First Date`) > = 1990;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.XCL_001 = P.XCL_058
WHERE E.XCL_006 = 'normal'
  AND E.XCL_002 > '1990-01-01'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_058)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE l.XCL_043 > 80 AND l.XCL_043 < 500
  AND p.XCL_061 >= '1990-01-01'
